🔥 The fire settles. Devon has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A dog-shaped silence at the treeline — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the woman in her 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm mutters "And you're still standing." Clarisse asks "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
